title: The Road Meets the Map
subtitle: A dependency that leaves its own chapter group
description: The survey's last line does not come from the survey: it comes
from `the_underground`, the final quest of `first_light`, in
another chapter group entirely. The format's `dependsOn` resolves
across groups, and this quest is the worked example -- a road that
is not finished until the road it surveyed has been walked.
The editor draws the cross-group edge exactly like any other line,
and the validator checks it exactly like any other dependency: an
id that resolves to nothing is an error, whatever group it was
